---
name: Website bug
about: Report a reproducible problem with the public website
title: "[Bug] "
---

### What happened?

Describe the problem and what you expected instead.

### How can we reproduce it?

Include the page URL, steps, browser/device, language, and light/dark mode when relevant.

### Evidence

Add a screenshot or a short error message if useful. Remove private information before posting.

> For a security vulnerability, follow the [security policy](https://github.com/zhixiang-ren/zhixiang-ren.github.io/security/policy) rather than opening a public issue.
